B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction (e.g., 3 = 15/5 or 2 = 16/8)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCM/common denominator without converting a mixed/whole number
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite each fraction as an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator
A step scales numerators/denominators to express fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
Only subtracting numerators after denominators match (without showing the matching process)

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference once quantities are expressed in compatible forms (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts by decomposing mixed numbers into whole and fractional parts (e.g., (3−3)+(4/5−2/5))
A step handles zero results from identical quantities (e.g., 2/3 − 2/3 = 0)
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms (mixed↔improper) without performing the subtraction
Only reducing/simplifying the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express an improper fraction as a mixed number or integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by a common factor (e.g., 21/12 reduced to 7/4)
A step states a fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or to an integer (e.g., 8/8 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing subtraction without any reduction or final-form statement
Only finding a common denominator or converting mixed numbers to improper fractions

C.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCM/common denominator without converting mixed/whole numbers
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and express each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator
A step scales numerator/denominator to rewrite fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without aligning denominators between two fractions

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed with a common denominator or as separated whole-and-fraction parts.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a shared denominator (e.g., a/b − c/b)
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately and combines the result
exclusion_criteria: Only performing conversions to common forms without executing the subtraction
Only reducing/simplifying the final fraction without doing the subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express an equivalent final form (integer or mixed number) consistent with answer rules.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by a common factor to lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or identifies an integer result (e.g., 8/8 = 1, 0/3 = 0)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator or converting forms prior to subtraction
Subtraction steps that do not include reduction or final-form conversion

A.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only simplifying a fraction without changing between mixed/improper/whole forms
Only finding a common denominator without converting mixed/whole numbers

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and express each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM/common denominator for two denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to rewrite fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the step proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed with a common denominator or decomposed into whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a shared denominator (a/b − c/b)
A step subtracts by separating whole and fractional parts (e.g., (A−B)+(a/b−c/b))
A step handles zero results from subtracting equal quantities
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting forms (mixed↔improper) without performing subtraction
Only reducing/simplifying after subtraction is already done

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or identifies an integer result (e.g., 8/8=1, 0/3=0)
A step states the result is already in lowest terms
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator before subtraction
Only performing subtraction without any reduction or final-form conversion
